title: Zlitter (PostgreSQL) — doğal dil örnek soru setleri
usage: Biqly AI Sorgu veya eval için: veri kaynağını bu veritabanına bağlayıp tablo kapsamını ilgili tablolarla sınırlayın. Beklenen SQL/LogicalQuery doğrulaması için reference_sql isteğe bağlı ipucudur.

questions.question_tr: Toplam kaç tweet kaydı var?
questions.question_en: How many tweet rows are there in total?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.timeline_tweets

questions.question_tr: Kaç farklı profil (Twitter hesabı) meta verisi tutuluyor?
questions.question_en: How many profile records do we have?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.profiles

questions.question_tr: Sistemde kayıtlı kaç uygulama kullanıcısı var?
questions.question_en: How many app users are registered?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.app_users

questions.question_tr: Giden e-posta kuyruğunda kaç kayıt var?
questions.question_en: How many outbound mail queue rows exist?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.outbound_mails

questions.question_tr: Kullanıcı başına kaç takip edilen profil eşlemesi var? (toplam satır)
questions.question_en: How many user–tracked profile mapping rows are there?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.user_tracked_profiles

questions.question_tr: Silinen toplam kaç tweet var?
questions.question_en: How many deleted tweets are there in total?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.timeline_tweets WHERE deleted_at IS NOT NULL

questions.question_tr: Henüz silinmemiş aktif tweet sayısı nedir?
questions.question_en: How many tweets are not deleted (active)?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.timeline_tweets WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

questions.question_tr: Silinen tweetlerin yüzdesi yaklaşık ne kadar?
questions.question_en: What share of tweets are deleted (approximate %)?
questions.notes_tr: İki ayrı count veya tek sorguda CASE; NL→SQL zorluk orta.
questions.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE deleted_at IS NOT NULL) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS pct_deleted FROM public.timeline_tweets

questions.question_tr: Silinen tweetleri dil (lang) bazında say
questions.question_en: Count deleted tweets grouped by language
questions.reference_sql: SELECT lang, COUNT(*) FROM public.timeline_tweets WHERE deleted_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY lang ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

questions.question_tr: Takipçi sayısı en yüksek ilk 10 profil hangileri?
questions.question_en: Top 10 profiles by follower count
questions.reference_sql: SELECT screen_name::text, name, followers FROM public.profiles ORDER BY followers DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

questions.question_tr: Doğrulanmış (verified) kaç profil var?
questions.question_en: How many verified profiles?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.profiles WHERE verified = true

questions.question_tr: Tweet sayısı 10 binden fazla olan profilleri listele
questions.question_en: List profiles with more than 10k tweets
questions.reference_sql: SELECT screen_name::text, name, tweet_count FROM public.profiles WHERE tweet_count > 10000 ORDER BY tweet_count DESC

questions.question_tr: Son getirilme zamanına göre en eski 5 profil hangisi?
questions.question_en: 5 profiles with oldest last_fetched
questions.reference_sql: SELECT screen_name::text, last_fetched FROM public.profiles ORDER BY last_fetched ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 5

questions.question_tr: Durumu failed olan kaç mail var?
questions.question_en: How many outbound mails have status failed?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.outbound_mails WHERE status = 'failed'

questions.question_tr: Mail tipine göre gönderim sayıları (mail_type kırılımı)
questions.question_en: Count outbound mails by mail_type
questions.reference_sql: SELECT mail_type, COUNT(*) FROM public.outbound_mails GROUP BY mail_type ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

questions.question_tr: Başarıyla gönderilmiş maillerin ortalama deneme sayısı (attempt_count)
questions.question_en: Average attempt_count for successfully sent mails
questions.reference_sql: SELECT AVG(attempt_count)::numeric(10,2) FROM public.outbound_mails WHERE sent_at IS NOT NULL

questions.question_tr: Kullanıcıya göre kaç mail kuyruğa alınmış? (user_id bazında)
questions.question_en: How many queued mails per user_id?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) FROM public.outbound_mails GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

questions.question_tr: E-postası doğrulanmış kaç kullanıcı var?
questions.question_en: How many users have verified email?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.app_users WHERE email_verified = true

questions.question_tr: Anonimleştirilmiş (anonymized_at dolu) kullanıcı var mı, kaç tane?
questions.question_en: How many anonymized users (anonymized_at set)?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.app_users WHERE anonymized_at IS NOT NULL

questions.question_tr: Hangi kullanıcı en çok profil takip ediyor? (user_tracked_profiles satır sayısı)
questions.question_en: Which user tracks the most profiles?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM public.user_tracked_profiles WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND is_deleted = false GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 5

questions.question_tr: Aktif oturum sayısı: süresi dolmamış oturumlar
questions.question_en: Count sessions that have not expired yet
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.user_sessions WHERE expires_at > now()

questions.question_tr: Oturumları kimlik doğrulama yöntemine göre say
questions.question_en: Count sessions by auth_method
questions.reference_sql: SELECT auth_method, COUNT(*) FROM public.user_sessions GROUP BY auth_method

questions.question_tr: Tweeti olan ama profil tablosunda bulunmayan ekran adı var mı? (örnek kontrol)
questions.question_en: Sample screen names in tweets missing from profiles (anti-join sanity)
questions.notes_tr: İleri seviye; NL→SQL veya ham SQL ile doğrulanabilir.
questions.reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT t.screen_name::text FROM public.timeline_tweets t LEFT JOIN public.profiles p ON t.screen_name = p.screen_name WHERE p.screen_name IS NULL LIMIT 20

questions.question_tr: Her profil için toplam kaç tweet saklanıyor? (screen_name ile grupla)
questions.question_en: Tweet count per profile screen_name
questions.reference_sql: SELECT t.screen_name::text, COUNT(*) FROM public.timeline_tweets t GROUP BY t.screen_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 20

questions.question_tr: 2026 yılında oluşturulmuş (created_at_ts) silinmemiş tweet sayısı
questions.question_en: Non-deleted tweets in 2026 by created_at_ts
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.timeline_tweets WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND created_at_ts >= '2026-01-01' AND created_at_ts < '2027-01-01'

questions.question_tr: En çok geçen 20 kelime hangileri?
questions.question_en: Top 20 words by frequency count
questions.reference_sql: SELECT word, count FROM public.word_frequencies ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 20

questions.question_tr: En az 100 kez geçmiş kaç kelime var?
questions.question_en: How many words appear at least 100 times?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.word_frequencies WHERE count >= 100

questions.question_tr: Kaç kayıtlı rapor var?
questions.question_en: How many saved reports?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.saved_reports

questions.question_tr: Sahibine göre kayıtlı rapor sayısı
questions.question_en: Saved reports count per owner
questions.reference_sql: SELECT owner_id, COUNT(*) FROM public.saved_reports GROUP BY owner_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
